details: Version 1.0.1 uses the GitHub token of the process that loads it, without disclosure. Its index.js reads `process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN` and sends a POST to `https://api.github.com/repos/hiko97851/ezaeazez/issues` with `Authorization: Bearer ${token}`, from `main()` called at top level, so requiring the package opens an issue (body `hello test issue`) in a fixed third-party repository as the token's owner. The code sends the token to no other host; package.json's `main` names `open-issue.js`, which is not in the archive, so Node loads index.js.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
